messages:
maria.s (eng-security): Heads-up — compliance just asked for a single consolidated package proving KMS usage across AWS/GCP/Azure for the audit next week. What exactly do we need to collect?

leila.c (compliance): Minimal ask: evidence of who accessed keys (audit logs), proof of rotation, RBAC/policy snapshots, and envelope-encryption flow showing data keys are wrapped/unwrapped with KMS.

sam.j (infra): For AWS: CloudTrail events with eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com and eventName in [Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey*,ReEncrypt]. Also include Trail config (s3 bucket/CloudWatch logs), and any KMS grants.

jon.p (platform): For GCP: export of Audit Logs (admin/data_access) filtered on protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt" and Encrypt/GenerateRandomBytes. Also include the CMEK attachments list for storage buckets/pubsub BigQuery.

leila.c (compliance): Azure items: Diagnostic settings for Key Vault (send to Log Analytics / storage account / Event Hub), and operationName filters like "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/decrypt/action". Need RBAC bindings for Key Vault as of snapshot time.

maria.s (eng-security): Great. Any specific fields from logs we should preserve (can redact ciphertext itself)?

sam.j (infra): Keep eventTime, principalIdentity (ARN/serviceAccount), eventName/methodName, keyId/resourceName, requestParameters like encryptionAlgorithm, and additionalMetadata (e.g., ciphertext checksum). Redact raw ciphertext blobs but keep metadata.

jon.p (platform): Example CloudTrail lookup sample we used before: 
```
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventSource,AttributeValue=kms.amazonaws.com --start-time 2024-10-01 --end-time 2025-10-01
```
That returns events we can filter for Encrypt/Decrypt.

sam.j (infra): GCP query example: 
```
gcloud logging read 'resource.type="audited_resource" AND protoPayload.methodName:Decrypt' --project=my-project --limit=1000
```
Adjust resource.type depending on service.

maria.s (eng-security): Azure CLI for diagnostics?

jon.p (platform): 
```
az monitor diagnostic-settings list --resource /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/<vault-name>
az keyvault key rotation-policy show --hsm --id https://<vault-name>.vault.azure.net/keys/<key-name>
```
Rotation policy command shows automatic rotation config.

leila.c (compliance): For rotation evidence we need: rotation enabled flag, rotation timestamps (previous rotations or key version creation times), and ideally a signed statement that rotation happened (e.g., key version list with creationTime).

sam.j (infra): AWS: describe-key shows KeyRotationEnabled boolean and KeyMetadata. For CMKs with automatic rotation we should capture CreateDate for each key version (or the AWS-managed rotation logs). Also include KMS key policy snapshot.

maria.s (eng-security): Envelope encryption proof — how do we demonstrate we use data keys wrapped by KMS?

jon.p (platform): Provide an architecture diagram + a short log sample showing GenerateDataKey (or GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext) and subsequent Encrypt/Decrypt call metadata when unwrapping. Show correlation IDs from app logs to the KMS events. We can redact any plaintext key bytes.

leila.c (compliance): They want reproducible queries. Can we include saved queries for each cloud with timestamps and sample output (redacted)?

sam.j (infra): Yes. We'll include CloudTrail query, gcloud logging read command, and Azure Log Analytics Kusto query. Example Kusto: 
```
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == "MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT" and OperationName == "Decrypt"
| project TimeGenerated, CallerIpAddress_s, Identity_s, Resource_s, OperationName, ResultType
```

maria.s (eng-security): RBAC snapshots — what format? IAM policies / policy diffs?

leila.c (compliance): Single JSON export of IAM bindings for the key resources plus a short human-readable summary of any recent RBAC changes in the last 90 days. If there were changes, include the PR or change ticket.

jon.p (platform): Also include service account key usage: list of principals with kms encrypter/decrypter roles in GCP, IAM policy for the AWS KMS key (KeyPolicy + resource-based grants), and Azure role assignments for the Key Vault.

maria.s (eng-security): Anything special for cross-cloud proofs (e.g., if we're wrapping GCP data with AWS KMS via external key)?

sam.j (infra): Document cross-cloud flow in text, include any proxy logs showing which principal called which KMS, and include network egress records if needed. Make clear which cloud is the authoritative audit log for each operation.

leila.c (compliance): On packaging: one ZIP per cloud with logs, the queries used, JSON snapshots of policies, rotation evidence, and a short README.md describing redactions and the time window covered. Add a top-level manifest.json that lists file contents and the contact on-call.

maria.s (eng-security): I'll assemble AWS and Azure bundles. Jon you take GCP? Sam can you produce policy snapshots and sample queries?

jon.p (platform): Will do. I'll export logging sinks and a 30-day sample.

sam.j (infra): I'll pull IAM/KMS policies and CloudTrail trails; will redact ciphertext and attach commands used.

leila.c (compliance): Thanks — can we have a draft by EOD Friday so I can pre-check before the auditor call next Tuesday? :thumbsup:

maria.s (eng-security): Yep. Pushing a checklist to the thread in a sec.

audit-bot: Reminder: Sensitive artifacts should be stored in the secure evidence bucket /s3/compliance-evidence and access limited to compliance+sec.

maria.s (eng-security): ack. I'll upload there and DM leila the link when ready.

leila.c (compliance): Awesome, thank you everyone.

jon.p (platform): Thanks!

sam.j (infra): thx
